setting_notes: Wilderness survival in a forest with social, physiological, and exploratory drives. Nodes abstract places, tools, hazards, rituals and acts of seeking, sustaining, aiding, trusting. Middle-layer verbs/nouns map from scenario actions to primitive operators or entities; most ontology nodes and all drives connect via plausible, primitive-anchored paths.

verbs.gloss: seek overview of surroundings or situation

conceal self or item from detection

move onward toward location or outcome
cease action and remain for event/condition

ready or arrange for future action
keep watch over state or scene
